people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors, and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.
translations.bsb: They also delivered the king’s edicts to the royal satraps and governors of the region west of the Euphrates, who proceeded to assist the people and the house of God.
translations.kjv: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
translations.asv: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's satraps, and to the governors beyond the River: and they furthered the people and the house of God.
